colour_scale.kind: linear, symmetric, fixed for every frame and both views

sphere_view.deduplication: samples with i < M/2 represent each pair
sphere_view.interpolation: linear on the spherical Delaunay triangulation (convex hull) of the unique samples, front-facing triangles only

torus_view.interpolation: linear on the triangles of the hexagonal index lattice, wrapped at both periodic boundaries
torus_view.edge_ticks: one tick on the v = 0 and v = 1 edges, two ticks on the u = 0 and u = 1 edges

playback.sampling: target evaluated at each display slot midpoint; nearest saved t_s, exact ties to the earlier snapshot; holds use the first and last snapshots
